title: The Bitcoin research queue is on hold until you choose
paragraphs: Three rule ideas are left to test: squeeze break, money flow and near high. Before a rule is run, the lab checks that its own test could recognise a rule that really works. On daily Bitcoin candles it cannot: even if a rule really earned about 2% a trade on top of its costs, the test would admit it in only 8.5%, 8.8% and 15.0% of simulated histories (at best, against the lab's own bar of 20%), because these slow rules make too few trades to judge.
Nothing has been run or changed while this waits. The paper accounts go on as before, and the research hours only check the system and write "no change".

options.text: Stop the daily queue here and keep the fifteen rule families already tested as the research record. On daily candles, more rules of this kind add chances of a lucky pass but almost no information.

Add data so that the tests have more trades to judge (other coins, an earlier start or finer candles). Hourly candles are the only choice that gives enough trades; it widens the scope, so a power check for hourly data would come first.

Lower the bar and run the three rules anyway. Expect a rejection in 85% to 92% of histories even if a real edge were there, and the number of rule settings tried goes from 113 to 143, which raises the chance that one passes by luck.

how_to_answer: Reply in the chat with 1, 2 or 3, or ask for more detail. Nothing in the app can send an answer. The numbers are in btcquant/BUILD_PLAN.md (step 14e) and btcquant/DATA_OPTIONS.md.
